tagline: Get referred. Get noticed. Get hired.

theme.description: Clean, crisp, high-trust SaaS interface inspired by Linear, Stripe, and Wellfound. Pure white/soft zinc canvases with deep charcoal typography and vibrant Emerald accents for credibility, verified status, and referral momentum.

primary.description: Primary brand CTA, active tabs, referral submit buttons, key verified states

primary_surface.description: Soft tint background for badges, active navigation rows, AI match pill background

primary_border.description: Delicate border for referral highlight cards and verified candidate containers

charcoal_primary.description: Primary typography, main headings, prominent card titles

charcoal_secondary.description: Subheadings, job descriptions, body copy, active table text

charcoal_muted.description: Secondary metadata, timestamps, location indicators, helper texts

background_canvas.description: App and dashboard canvas background to provide subtle contrast with white cards

background_card.description: Clean surface for cards, navigation bar, tables, sheets, and dialogs

border_default.description: 1px crisp structural border on cards, inputs, table rows, and headers

border_subtle.description: Dividers, inner card sections, table stripe borders

status_warning.description: Pending verification, Under Review, Interview scheduled

status_info.description: Role tags, In progress application, Requested state

match_score_gradient.description: Used in SVG radial match progress rings (85%+ = #059669, 70-84% = #10B981, <70% = #F59E0B)

typography.font_family_primary: Geist Sans, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, Roboto, sans-serif

scale.h1_hero: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-extrabold tracking-tight text-slate-900 leading-[1.1]

rules: Never use Inter or generic sans for display headings. Rely on Geist Sans with explicit tracking-tight.
Always maintain 2-3x font weight contrast (e.g. font-bold 700 title paired with font-normal 400 metadata).
Overlines and role category badges must use tracking-widest text-xs uppercase.

JobCard.style: bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl p-5 hover:border-emerald-300 hover:shadow-md transition-all duration-200 relative group cursor-pointer
key_elements: Role title with hover:text-emerald-700 font-semibold text-slate-900
Company name + Verified Employee Referral Badge (Emerald pill)
Location, Job Type (Remote/Hybrid), Salary range pills
AI Match ring or percentage pill (e.g., 94% Match)
Footer with date posted + Request Referral CTA or Refer Candidate CTA

CandidateCard.style: bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl p-5 hover:border-slate-300 transition-all shadow-sm
key_elements: Candidate full name, target role, current experience level (e.g. 5+ yrs)
Top 3-4 skills tags in subtle slate badges
Match score to current open positions

rules: NO slow drawn-out animations; keep interactive transitions under 220ms.
Modal backdrop fades in 150ms, dialog scales from 0.98 to 1.0.
Dropdown menus appear with opacity 0 -> 1 and translateY(-4px -> 0px).
Tab transitions should be instantaneous with subtle underline slide.
Respect prefers-reduced-motion: if enabled, disable all transforms.

navigation_architecture.role_switcher_banner: Include a prominent demo banner or floating switcher in the header so test evaluators can switch seamlessly between Public, Candidate, Employee, Company HR, and Admin views with one click.

rules: Every button, input, tab, card, and modal action MUST have a role-based kebab-case data-testid.

Examples: data-testid='request-referral-btn', data-testid='refer-candidate-confirm-btn', data-testid='filter-remote-checkbox', data-testid='role-switcher-employee', data-testid='timeline-stage-interview', data-testid='ai-match-score-pill'.

anti_patterns_banlist: NO dark violet or purple neon gradients (strictly stick to clean Emerald #059669 and Slate).
NO glassmorphism overuse that obscures data readability in tables and lists.
NO generic AI robot emojis (🤖, 🧠, 💡) for icons — use clean Lucide icons (Sparkles, ShieldCheck, CheckCircle2, UserCheck, Flame, Zap).
NO card-for-everything clutter; use clean border-collapse tables with subtle row dividing lines for dense lists.
NO pure black (#000000) text; always use warm Slate-900 (#0F172A).
NO full screen blocking spinners; use subtle skeleton lines or inline indicator.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Referly is an ultra-crisp, trustworthy career marketplace. Think Stripe Dashboard meets Linear and Wellfound.
Keep standard light theme as default with high contrast borders (slate-200), pure white card surfaces, and zinc-50 background.
Use Recharts with Emerald (#059669), Teal (#0D9488), Indigo (#4F46E5), and Amber (#D97706) for referral funnels and conversion analytics.

Mock realistic data: include realistic company names (Stripe, Vercel, Linear, Datadog), real salary numbers ($140k - $210k), verifiable skill tags (React, Next.js, Go, TypeScript), and Indian + international diverse candidate profiles.

Build interactive modals: 'Request a Referral' (with note to employee, LinkedIn link, resume upload preview), 'Refer Candidate' (with referral reason, relationship dropdown), and 'Improve JD with AI' inside the job creation flow.
Ensure the mobile bottom nav handles quick role switching or primary app actions on screens under 768px.
